notes.title: Playtest in numbers! Plus info about release
notes.notes:
Aloha! 💙



We would like to share a few words regarding the Gambonanza playtest that ended last week, as well as our plans for the release.



[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXd_MsYTRqmddAU7qEF9ZO6gMGgfsNRU5FIHPem1jwhgU2bckOC-W7Mu_IdkFfPcJiIxXTcKO44OHBwn5sEzmpMeJKjMiTd2rq9SpvvCChhwOiH_6QCjCLD0AT_zTNe_k_Vbr1fuXQ?key=1lpfcvrEtVjPRHM8adtkyA"]
Let’s sum it up


We are extremely grateful for the amazing help we received throughout the playtest! 🙇



Here are some crazy numbers we reached together:



10,000 players on Steam

400 daily active players on Steam

1,150 hours watched on Twitch

450 new members on Discord

30+ bugs fixed 🔧



Thank you all so much for taking part in this adventure!


Regarding release


We were happily surprised by the overwhelmingly large amount of positive feedback we received! It was an immense pleasure to read about your experiences and ideas. ❤️



The goal now is to address your findings and improve the game further. There are plenty of surprises to add, new gambits, new tiles, challenges, achievements, bosses, and much more! This does unfortunately mean that the release will be pushed back a few months.



As the developer, we are certain this is the best choice for both Gambonanza and you, the players! And the end result will be even more fun and polished.



Thank you for your patience and understanding - we will make sure to keep you up to date with the progress! There is no specific date in mind yet. The best way to be the first to know when we share something new?


[olist]
Here on Steam (wishlist and follow)

On our Discord: https://discord.gg/H3FbvFN2sE  

On our socials 📸
[/olist]


We had some fun, but this is only the beginning! We’ve come this far together, and the best part of the journey is still ahead. Let’s make Gambonanza the best it can be!


See you over the board! ♟️

- Blukulélé and Stray Fawn Publishing
